title: All two-rune starts for one feedback rule
question: Can searching every pair of starting key values, including unequal values, reveal an English-like reading under the two-rune plaintext-sum feedback rule?
reader_question: Could two unequal starting values reveal an English-like page under this feedback rule?
summary: All 841 starts on 55 pages produced no candidate above the fixed English-score gate. Both known control passages were recovered under each of three unequal starts; 40 of 49 shuffled whole searches scored at least as highly as the manuscript.
finding: The full 46,255-case grid has best score −6.504483411536969 on LP2-49 with primer [11,8], below −5.5. The 1,595 overlapping diagonal cases have best −6.557488304189059; 44,660 off-diagonal cases extend the baseline. No candidate meets score >= max(−5.5, largest 49-shuffle maximum + 0.5). Forty of 49 whole-search shuffled maxima are at least the observed maximum. All six controls (two texts × three primers) recover completely and rank uniquely first among 841; native-source control parity and independent all-target scores and decodes match exactly.
reader_finding: Unequal starts improved the best score slightly, but no candidate passed the fixed English-score gate. Forty of 49 shuffled searches scored at least as highly.
reader_limit: One two-rune plaintext-feedback rule and one English scorer only. The controls reuse two known passages; this does not exclude other autokey rules or plaintext languages.
limitations: Other six source functions, other history sources, k outside 2, sign +1, reversed/continuous/word-reset streams, skips, other alphabets or languages, broader autokey exclusion and plaintext identification. The six plants reuse two texts; 49 null searches do not establish a general probability. Independent checking reconstructs all 46,255 target outputs and scores and 49 null maximum witnesses, but not every nonwinning shuffled candidate. The manuscript maximum comes from a short 66-rune page.
next_steps: Inspect any concrete alternative recurrence or plaintext-language proposal under a separately frozen, control-validated scope; do not treat the finite score result as a whole-family exclusion.

reproduction.environment: Recorded Python 3.12.10, NumPy 2.5.4 and Numba 0.67.0; exact package pins in requirements.txt. Install dependencies separately; no network or package installs by scripts. All required source, scorer, transcription and known-control bytes are bundled. Replay uses a temporary output directory, checks deterministic values and exact score bytes, and leaves expected files unchanged.
